en.html:
Throw off Hikaru's arms—
Find the sword I had dropped—
Get away from the crystal. Run—

With all the strength of my life, I attempted every one.
Not one would obey me.

Hikaru did not release me. The sword was nowhere I could identify. The crystal approached.

No escape.

I put my final resistance into my gaze.

Dug the hatred from the deepest seams of my soul, and hurled the result at her.

Hikaru looked back.

Only gentleness.

That gentleness drove me to despair.

en.html:
Words that left my mouth without thought.

Hikaru's eyes opened wide.

—A mistake.

The knowledge came that instant.

I had chosen entirely the wrong words.

Her face was frozen.
Hurt.

Her gaze swung back to Muramasa. I could no longer see her eyes—but Muramasa's instinctive backward step allowed me to imagine them.

Hikaru had become destruction's impulse given form.
